name: sol-advisor
description: Haru fork of Sol Advisor with a High-default primary effort preflight plus explicit Sol/Luna/Terra model-specific implementation, research, and review routing.

interface.shortDescription: Sol starts High, redirects bounded work to fresh Medium, then routes model-pinned auxiliaries selectively.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor starts GPT-6.1 Sol / High by default and performs a tool-free primary-effort gate before substantive work. Bounded low-to-moderate-risk tasks are redirected to a fresh GPT-6.1 Sol / Medium task rather than changing effort in-session; architecture ambiguity, complex RCA, wide blast radius, irreversible/security/data-loss/production risk, expensive retry cost, and acceptance-critical work remain on High. After the primary effort matches, implementation and research routing preserve the existing model-pinned Luna/Terra lanes, fresh Sol review, fail-closed runtime evidence, read-only researchers, and progressive-disclosure contracts.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to run the PRIMARY EFFORT gate before task tools. Start from Sol / High by default; if the task is medium-recommended, stop and restart it as a fresh Sol / Medium task instead of switching effort in-session.
After the primary effort matches, declare the SELECTIVE ROUTE and preserve the existing model-pinned Luna/Terra implementation, research, runtime-evidence, and review contracts.
